datasetMetadata.title: Multi-Cluster Clearing & Speckle Filtering (Synthetic)
datasetMetadata.description: Synthetic 30×30 multi-region dataset containing 4 substantive change clusters (45, 24, 16, and 12 pixels), 2 small noise speckles (3 and 2 pixels) removed by minimum-size filtering, and 60 cloud-masked pixels.

classificationMaskCodes.1: FILTERED_CANDIDATE_CHANGE (exceeded threshold but removed by minComponentSize)
classificationMaskCodes.2: RETAINED_CHANGE (exceeded threshold and belongs to retained component)
classificationMaskCodes.-1: INVALID (excluded by validity mask or zero NDVI denominator)
